semiconductor_relevance: High — Chemfish Tokyo Co., Ltd. specializes in advanced materials technologies specifically for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Chemfish Tokyo Co., Ltd. develops and supplies advanced materials for the semiconductor sector, focusing on fluorine chemistry and electronic fluorination solutions. The company also provides cleaning agents and environmentally friendly products tailored for semiconductors, communications, and data centers.

regional_presence.China: Chemfish is based in China and focuses on the development of advanced materials technologies.
regional_presence.Japan: Japan serves as a strategic base for Chemfish to meet the needs of global customers.
